records.part: Acquisition and installation of one FAA Level D Qualified 747-8i Full Flight Simulator and Initial Logistics Support Package
records.reason: CAE is the only responsible source and no other types of supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements (see RFO 6.103-1, 10 USC 3204(a)(1)). CAE is the only contractor with the unique qualifications to manufacture a commercial, FAA Level D certified 747-8i FFS.
